newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks up at noon in speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks up at noon in speculative buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks were higher at midsession on Sunday as individuals squared short positions amid hopes of foreign buying, dealers said.
They said speculative buying in anticipation of fresh New Year buying by foreign funds prompted the position-squaring.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 7.37 points, or 0.54 percent, to 1,377.70 at midday. Losers led gainers 75 to 63.
ICI Pakistan rose 0.65 rupees to 18.40 rupees and PTCL 0.15 to 25.85. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
